one_liner: Error tracking and performance monitoring platform with a comprehensive web API and official MCP server.
access_notes: Sentry provides a free developer plan with self-serve access to credentials, user tokens, and OAuth.
verdict_reason: Sentry offers public REST APIs and an official MCP server with self-serve developer access via a free tier.

evidence.snippet: Authentication tokens are passed using an auth header, and are used to authenticate as a user or organization account with the API.
For third-party applications that need to access Sentry on behalf of users, Sentry supports OAuth2 with the authorization code grant type.
The Sentry MCP is Sentry's hosted Model Context Protocol server at mcp.sentry.dev — the official integration surface Sentry maintains.
developer $0 Includes: One user, Error Monitoring and Tracing, 10 custom dashboards, MCP access
